Post 1
📈 ASX 200 just hit a 100-day high. Up 90.80pts or 1.01% to 9,038.60, now just 1.79% off the 52-week peak. Health Care led the charge. The bull case is quietly being rebuilt. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2
🟢 Health Care surged +4.24%, Consumer Discretionary +2.37%. Every sector closed green. Financials lagged at +0.18%. Breadth this clean is rare — this wasn't a rotation, it was a broad re-rating. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 3
CSL up 8.550 AUD or +7.15% to 128.070 AUD. Single-stock move that dragged the whole index higher. When the largest health care name runs like this, it matters at the index level. #ASX #healthcare

Post 4
🪙 Gold at 5,830.80 AUD/oz with AUD/USD at 0.6942. A firmer Aussie dollar caps local gold returns even as the underlying metal holds strength. Miners caught both tailwinds and currency drag today. #ASX #gold #mining

Post 5
ASX sits 1.79% from its 52-week high. The question now: does momentum carry through, or does resistance cap the run? Watch that high as the line in the sand. What's your call — breakout or fade? #ASX #ausbiz
